page.overview:
Who is Rainbow Dash?

Rainbow Dash is a female Pegasus pony and one of the main characters in My Little Pony Friendship is Magic. She maintains the weather and clears the skies in Ponyville. As a huge fan of the Wonderbolts, she becomes a reservist member of the elite flying group in Testing Testing 1, 2, 3 and a full member in Newbie Dash. In Sonic Rainboom, Rarity and Princess Celestia both declare that she is the best flier in all of Equestria. Rainbow Dash has a pet tortoise named Tank, whom she acquires from Fluttershy in the episode May the Best Pet Win! She represents the element of loyalty.__TOC__

Lauren Faust was inspired to create Rainbow Dash by G1 pony Firefly. In the preliminary character designs posted by Faust, Rainbow Dash originally had Firefly's color scheme and cutie mark. Rainbow Dash shares a similar personality to Firefly, but shares a name with the G3 Earth pony Rainbow Dash. In her final design, Rainbow Dash is a Pegasus like Firefly, but has the same color scheme as her G3 counterpart. Her cutie mark is a combination of Firefly's lightning bolts, and her G3 counterpart's clouds and rainbow coloring.

After Faust left the show, General Firefly, mentioned in Testing Testing 1, 2, 3, was named after Faust's social media username "fyre_flye" which she in turn named after Firefly, stated to be her favorite G1 pony.

Faust gave Rainbow Dash messy hair and straight eyelashes to hint at her dynamic nature. Rainbow Dash shares her design and eye color with Daring Do and WCE Unnamed Mare - Jouster, her design with Skywishes, Sugar Grape, Lucky Dreams, Sweetsong, Breezie, Feathermay, Periwinkle, Star Dasher, and sometimes Ploomette and Banana Bliss, her mane and tail style with Holly Dash, "Doseydotes", "Ballad", Léon, and Roku-chan, her mane style with Andrea, her tail style with "Sunstone", and her coat and eye colors with Shoeshine, Eclair Crème, Screwy, "Turf", "Bloo", "Tough Love", and Micro 02 Unnamed Mare - Alicorn.
